rd_ce.publisher: Secrétariat général pour l’investissement, counter-expertise of the appraisal of NExTEO (H. de Tréglodé, Q. Roquigny, P. Ducos), December 2019, section 2.3.7
rd_ce.about: Study of 2012-13 by RFF for the STIF, with the SNCF, the RATP and Setec: a plain doubling of the tunnel ruled out because of the tie-ins at Châtelet-Les Halles (RATP study of 2003); only a new tunnel kept for RER D alone was studied, in four variants; RER D cut for 8 to 12 months, works of six years, interchanges between RER A, B and D degraded; 1.3 to 3.8 billion euros

rd_aut14.publisher: AUT Île-de-France (B. Gobitz), AUT-infos n°123, March-April 2014: doubling of the Châtelet to Gare du Nord tunnel
rd_aut14.about: RATP study of 2003: a second twin-tube tunnel beside the first, feasible, a little under 700 million euros (2012 values); main difficulty the tie-in to the existing station of Châtelet-Les Halles, which would close RER B and D during the works. RFF study given to the STIF in 2013: RER D diverted between Gare de Lyon and Gare du Nord, leaving its present station at Châtelet-Les Halles, with new underground stations of its own; four scenarios, one without a stop at Châtelet, one by way of République; two to over four billion euros

rd_sd03.publisher: STIF, summary of the RER B master plan, 2003
rd_sd03.about: A new RER D tunnel between Châtelet and Gare du Nord, to be studied for after 2015: about 500 million euros; it would separate the running of RER B and D and mainly allow more RER D trains

rd_stif14.publisher: STIF, RER D line committee, 10 July 2014, lessons of the studies of the second tunnel
rd_stif14.about: Second tunnel: 2 to 3.5 billion euros according to the scenario, keeping a station at Châtelet; the interconnection cut for about a year; traffic forecasts do not justify more than 12 trains an hour in the north

rd_qo256.publisher: Assemblée nationale, oral question n° 256, minister’s answer, March 2025
rd_qo256.about: A second tunnel between Châtelet and Gare du Nord: more than 2 billion euros, traffic stopped altogether for more than a year, hard to carry out; the master plan of RER D is preferred

rd_b23.publisher: Île-de-France Mobilités, RER B line committee, minutes of 27 November 2023
rd_b23.about: RER B in the shared tunnel: 17.5 trains an hour on average, in place of 20

rd_punct.about: Punctuality from January to April 2026: RER B 89.2%, RER D 83.0%, line P 89.3%, line N 93.6%

rd_vrt19.about: NExTEO on RER B and D, the new signalling chosen in place of a second tunnel: 788 million euros (2018 values)
